Winter in Moscow

Golden brick. Winter light.

An artistically compressed district around Red Square: Saint Basil’s Cathedral at the southern end, the Kremlin walls to the west and a representative GUM facade to the east. The Moskva River runs outside the square.

Drag to rotate. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Explore the square, switch between golden hour and blue hour, or pause the snowfall and city life.

Clock uses Moscow time. This is a place-inspired miniature, not a surveyed reconstruction. Scene lighting is controlled separately.
